summary: Save / load menu over the save plugin: a few named slots with the scene, play time and label the save plugin keeps for each (ctx.save.info), Save (in playable scenes), Load and Delete; open it from a pause or title button with open_panel(SaveSlots).
setup: Add a button whose action is open_panel(SaveSlots) to your pause or title panel; name the slots in config/save_slots.json.
